name: Asahi
message: 「Good morning, Iori-sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, morning, Asahi.」
I scan the classroom, confirming that only Asahi is here. It’s a sight I’ve grown accustomed to over the past few days.

name: Iori
message: 「Just you again today, Asahi. Attagirl.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Huh？ What do you mean by ‘attagirl’？」
If everyone had been sitting quietly in their seats like a bunch of model students, my burning passion for education—which had already reached a critical point—would have been dampened.

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, I apologize. I’ve finally woken up.」
Yes, Asahi had been consistent from the very beginning.
The others were just children whose mental age hadn't progressed past adolescence; they weren't the type of people who would listen to reason.

name: Iori
message: 「Up until yesterday, I was too soft, too kind. I lacked the necessary resolve.」

name: Iori
message: 「From today on, I will hold nothing back against them！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Y-you’ve finally realized it!」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, I understand now. Starting today, I’m going to need you to lend me your full support, Asahi！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, of course！」
We stare at each other. I feel like I’ve finally reached an understanding with Asahi.

name: Iori
message: 「Now then, time for a strategy meeting.」

name: Iori
message: 「Let’s think together about how we’re going to conquer the rest of them.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Understood!」

name: Iori
message: 「I had you follow Setsugekka yesterday, but what happened after that？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I’m sorry, unfortunately, I lost her...」

name: Iori
message: 「I see. Well, don’t let it bother you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I was frustrated, so I leaked the footage of Setsugekka acting all cocky to Keisetsu-san, along with the news about her skipping school.」

name: Iori
message: 「What was Keisetsu’s reaction？」

name: Asahi
message: 「She just said, ‘Hmph.’」
There it is. Keisetsu’s ‘hmph.’
When she reacts that way, it’s usually because she’s 『thoroughly unamused.’
Keisetsu probably scolded Setsugekka quite severely.
After all, she skipped school and ran away instead of receiving the instruction from the teacher that Keisetsu had gone out of her way to arrange for her.

name: Iori
message: 「Right, let’s press the attack. Any good ideas？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Well, I surmise that Setsugekka-san is the type who simply cannot resist once a carrot is dangled in front of her.」

name: Asahi
message: 「So, let’s scatter some bait.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, same principle as feeding animals, then.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, exactly!♪」
When housebreaking, you reward small successes with treats, gradually conditioning them to perform the desired behavior.
Until yesterday, I might have felt guilty about comparing a student to an animal, but today, I』m a different man.

name: Iori
message: 「In that case, I have an idea.」

name: Asahi
message: 「What are you going to do？」

name: Iori
message: 「Dietary restrictions.」
I say with a grin.

name: Iori
message: 「Starting today, Setsugekka is going to experience a hellish calorie-restricted diet.」

name: Iori
message: 「No rice, bread, noodles, or any other carbohydrates allowed whatsoever.」

name: Iori
message: 「But we’ll have a nutritionist prepare a special menu that maintains her muscle mass while properly supporting her nutritional needs.」
Normally, the support system for students’ diets is left to individual choice.
However, homeroom teachers have the authority to forcibly impose dietary restrictions on students with problematic eating habits.

name: Asahi
message: 「Is such a thing really possible？」

name: Iori
message: 「When I was a student here, one of my friends ate out way too much. He ended up gaining a lot of weight.」

name: Iori
message: 「He was switched to a calorie-restricted diet. He was even forbidden from snacking until the teacher gave him the all-clear.」

name: Asahi
message: 「She might just sneak out to buy food behind our backs, you know.」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s where I intend to get Keisetsu’s help.」

name: Iori
message: 「Keisetsu is likely the one managing the money and credits Setsugekka uses. I’ll have her place a limit on those.」

name: Iori
message: 「That way, within a few days, Setsugekka will be dying for some carbohydrates.」
In JGSDF Ranger training, trainees aren't given enough water.
The crushing thirst drives the trainees’ minds to the absolute brink. They use water as bait to squeeze every last drop of effort out of them.

name: Iori
message: 「By starving her of carbohydrates like that, I’ll be the one to offer a helping hand.」

name: Iori
message: 「‘Follow my guidance, and you’ll get to eat your fill,’ that’s the play！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehehe, a starvation tactic, is it? Splendid!」

name: Asahi
message: 「If we go with that method, there's no doubt she'll surrender to your authority, Iori-sensei.」
Asahi stares at me with a rapturous expression.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, next is Ririmu.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu-san is the type who sticks to her own guns. She’s the kind of girl who absolutely won’t do something if she isn’t convinced.」

name: Iori
message: 「So, the same method as Setsugekka won't work.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes. If you try to impose restrictions or punish her, she’ll just become stubborn and won't listen to a word you say.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I think a reward-based proposal would be best for her, where we provide the material she needs to come to her own conclusion.」
A reward-based approach... what would count as a reward for Ririmu？

name: Iori
message: 「...Should I use Asahi?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Me？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, since Ririmu is hostile toward you, Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I also consider Ririmu-san to be my <d0049>sworn enemy</d>.」
Exactly, I'll make use of that.
Ririmu isn't the only one; martial artists are born with an intense desire not to lose.
I’ll manipulate her by playing on the fact that she doesn't want to lose to Asahi—someone she hates—and lead her to want to receive guidance.

name: Iori
message: 「To do that, I'll need you to put on an act with me, Asahi.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, will you cooperate？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, of course.」

name: Iori
message: 「Thanks. And then... there's Momiji.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I’ve talked to Momiji-san a little, but she is quite formidable.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Half-baked strategies won't work on her. If anything, we’d be the ones backed into a corner.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I know.」
Compared to Setsugekka and Ririmu, Momiji is in a league of her own.
Her exceptional intelligence was perfectly clear just from watching her match with Victoria-san.
I've never seen anyone capable of constructing such a perfect read on the very first try. It’s clearly beyond that of a normal person.
If she were to apply that to daily life... it would be terrifying.

name: Iori
message: 「Do you have any good ideas for handling Momiji？」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, for now... I need a bit more information.」

name: Asahi
message: 「If I could just get a hold of some decisive dirt on her, but I don't think Momiji is going to show her tail that easily.」

name: Asahi
message: 「If we're going to probe her, I think we need to go all the way, by any means necessary.」

name: Iori
message: 「Granted. Do it thoroughly.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Understood.」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, the plan is set then.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well then, let's prepare to execute...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, there's something I want to ask of you before we do that.」

name: Iori
message: 「Something you want to ask of me？」

name: Asahi
message: 「This operation is extremely important to you, Iori-sensei, and I have no intention of sparing any effort to help you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「However... even if it is for your sake, Iori-sensei, those girls are people who will eventually become obstacles for me.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Leading them to receive your guidance, Iori-sensei, is like handing salt to the enemy.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Even I would like some kind of reward, at least...」
Ah, I suppose that makes sense.

name: Iori
message: 「Understood. I'll do whatever I can.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Really？ Anything？」

name: Iori
message: 「W-well, anything within reason.」
I wonder what on earth she's going to demand.

name: Asahi
message: 「In that case, I would like to request a private photoshoot.」

name: Iori
message: 「A photoshoot？ What are you going to shoot？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, isn't it obvious?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Of course, it's you, Iori-sensei♪」

name: Asahi
message: 「It's a session where you go shirtless, Iori-sensei, strike various poses, and let me photograph you to my heart's content.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I'm not a model, you know！？ And shirtless, of all things！」

name: Asahi
message: 「It's totally fine. Firefighters do it too.」

name: Iori
message: 「W-What do firefighters do？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Overseas, they have calendars featuring handsome, super-ripped firefighters posing shirtless, and they're hugely popular.」

name: Asahi
message: 「If you don't believe me, try searching for 'firefighter' and 'calendar'. They'll show up right at the top.」
I pull up my HR in private mode and run a Goggle search.

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, they really exist...」
A flood of images of macho firefighters with bursting pecs and abs came pouring onto the screen.

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm sure your body, honed in the Tenju Special Forces, is wonderful too, Iori-sensei. I would absolutely love to take some photos...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「If we released a photobook of you, Iori-sensei, it'd easily sell ten thousand copies.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hold on, you're planning to sell them？！」

name: Asahi
message: 「No, I wouldn't want to create more rivals, so I won't sell them. I'll just enjoy them privately for myself.」
Hmm, Asahi is going to be helping me out a lot with this whole thing, after all.
If all it costs is showing off my body a little, that's a small price to pay, I guess...

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, fine.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Huh, really？！」

name: Iori
message: 「Just don't go uploading them online or anything, okay？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, of course!」

name: Iori
message: 「L-Like this？」
Doing as Asahi told me, I took off my shirt and stood there bare-chested.

name: Asahi
message: 「Aaaah, yes, that's amazing, Iori-sensei!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Such muscular beauty, just as I imagined... I think I'm going to get wet.」

name: Iori
message: 「W-What is？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, I wonder what.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Haah, I just want to dive right into that thick chest of yours.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I can't hold back anymore, Iori-sensei... Please, catch me in your arms！」

name: Iori
message: 「NOOOO！？ Please refrain from touching！」
I beat a hasty retreat from Asahi as she creeps closer, making grabby hands at me.

name: Asahi
message: 「You're stingy, Iori-sensei.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Why are you so resistant？ Do you hate me？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, no, we're teacher and student, so I have to consider the morals of the situation...」

name: Asahi
message: 「At the point where we're having a photoshoot with you shirtless, doesn't 'morals' already go out the window？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ugh, true... but it's still a no！」

name: Iori
message: 「If you keep being selfish, I'm quitting this.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I understand. It's a shame, but I will refrain from touching.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, yeah, hurry up and start this 'photoshoot' thing.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Understood. Then, I shall begin the shoot.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ah, that's great~ Iori-sensei, you're wonderful~」

name: Asahi
message: 「Could you flex your pectoral muscles for me？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ah, yes, that's it, it's perfect.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Haa, haa... tighten your abs... ahh, yes, that pose, it's so sexy.」

name: Iori
message: 「I-is something like this okay？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, it's unbearable, I love you, Iori-sensei.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Your expression is also nice~」

name: Asahi
message: 「It's a smile so wonderful it would captivate women all over the world.」

name: Iori
message: 「O-oh... is that so?」
Being showered with such praise by Asahi, I start to feel a strange sensation.

name: Asahi
message: 「Aahh, that shy look... just how much, just how much more are you going to ruin people before you're satisfied...」

name: Asahi
message: 「There isn't a woman alive whose heart wouldn't race at those spread hands.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, you are nothing short of a masterpiece crafted by the gods.」

name: Iori
message: 「I-is it really... that much？」
Perhaps because of being constantly buttered up by Asahi, I can't help but get excited.

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, if there is any object in this life that I should pour my love into, it can only be you, Iori-sensei.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Sensei's body is even more beautiful than the famous Statue of David.」

name: Asahi
message: 「One could even say that your existence is the very condensation of this world's beauty.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Come now, Iori-Sensei, please, expose even more of your beautiful figure to me...！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, alright！ Keep snapping away！！」
The private photo session ended.

name: Asahi
message: 「Haaah... that was wonderful.」

name: Asahi
message: 「How was the photo session for you, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「It was insane...」
At first, it was just embarrassing—that was all.
But as I kept being photographed over and over, I could feel it gradually turning into pleasure myself.
Bathing in Asahi's passionate gaze, being praised by her every time I struck a pose, and the mysterious sense of euphoria that built up as I was showered in flashes.
I think I might have understood how a model feels, just a little.

name: Iori
message: 「How about you, Asahi？ Were you satisfied？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, my Iori-Sensei folder has been thoroughly enriched.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I likely won't ever be in need of fap material for the rest of my life.」
I think I'll refrain from asking what kind of 'material' that is...

name: Asahi
message: 「Let's hold another private photo session, okay?」

name: Iori
message: 「Cut it out！ I feel like I'm seriously going to end up crossing a line of no return！」
I can't afford to stray from the right path because of something like this.

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, with this, can I count on your help without any lingering reservations？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, a promise is a promise, after all.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I will serve you with every ounce of my heart and soul, Iori-Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright. Then, let's begin the operation preparations！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ohhh！」
